items: Salted, buttered, lightly sugared, and sautéed nuts, cooled

steps.title: Build the plate
steps.body: On an individual serving plate, place mixed greens, dried cranberries or sliced pears, salted, buttered, lightly sugared, and sautéed nuts, cooled, and crumbled feta cheese.

steps.title: Dress the salad
steps.body: Drizzle balsamic or light Caesar dressing over top.
